create_Task_instance: create a Task instance with a random seed for a dm_control continuous control task
get_action_spec: get the BoundedArraySpec for physics actuators using the Task action_spec method
initialize_episode: initialize a new episode by resetting geom colors via Task initialize_episode
set_actuator_control: set actuator control signals by calling Task before_step with an action and physics
toggle_visualize_reward: toggle reward visualization colors on a Task by setting the visualize_reward property
